body_html:
@mapkyca Just using the import Wordpress UI under site configuration->import.

Wondering if I should only try to import post types that would map well to Known, article, notes, bookmark, replies, etc and leave out post types not used like watch, listen, my podcats, etc. I don't think there is any use of post type discovery algorithms on import.

Wondering if post types missing in Known...could those default to status/notes if no title is present and to an article if a title is present?

I have no idea how images would be handled on import....maybe just best to archive old blogs.

Is XML best way for importing in future? Would json be better?
